payload.summary: Ran the spec and evidence phases. Both pass: 9/9 requirements verified against the live system, both critical spec sub-gates green. The pre-merge gate still halts because Smoke, Security, and E2E are required for this deployable surface and were not requested. One structural finding recorded about the shared task record.

decisions.title: Ran the traceability gate with --base-ref origin/main
decisions.rationale: Local main in this cloud clone is stale and divergent by 85 commits, so the default base cannot resolve a merge base. origin/main is the real integration branch; the gate then passed with no violation naming this change's capabilities.

decisions.title: Reverted declaring tasks.md in the implementation packages' write_allow
decisions.rationale: Declaring it satisfies this phase's cross-package rule but fails validate_scope_overlap, which forbids any write_allow overlap between parallel packages and exempts only wp-integration. Both directions were tried and each failure reproduced. Kept the package validator green, which is also the prevailing repo convention, and filed the contradiction as finding E1 rather than silently picking a side.

decisions.title: Recorded Smoke, Security, and E2E as skipped rather than not applicable
decisions.rationale: gate_logic classifies the surface deployable because the change edits agent-coordinator/src. A skills-only change could record them not applicable; this one cannot.

next_steps: Run /validate-feature add-skill-audit --phase deploy,smoke,security,e2e where a container runtime is available.
Then /cleanup-feature add-skill-audit once the pre-merge gate clears.
